llama_cpp_constants: llama.cpp master, gguf-py constants read 2026-09-01 (spec D4 section 0.4)
notes: the source tokenizer declares no bos token, so no tokenizer.ggml.bos_token_id is written and llama.cpp falls back to its own default id; add_bos_token is written False, so generation is unaffected unless a client opts into add_bos
norm weights are written verbatim: a Qwen-derived child already stores 1 + w, so llama.cpp's converter-side +1 must not be applied again
ssm_a is -exp(decay_log_scale); the parameter itself is the log scale
rank>=2 tensors take the file type, norms and per-head scalars stay float32, matching llama.cpp's own converters
